input.answer:
Regular self-serve gasoline was cheaper in Toronto in September 2026: 183.7 (as published, which is cents per litre for this table) versus 209.5 in Vancouver. That is 25.8 units lower in Toronto (209.5 − 183.7 = 25.8), or about 12.3% below Vancouver (25.8 / 209.5 = 12.3%).

For context, from August to September 2026:
- Toronto rose from 170.3 to 183.7, up 13.4 (13.4 / 170.3 = 7.9%).
- Vancouver rose from 206.7 to 209.5, up 2.8 (2.8 / 206.7 = 1.4%).

Notes: the tool did not return a unit label, so I've described the values as published. Both series are the monthly average retail price for "Regular unleaded gasoline at self service filling stations" (Toronto, Ontario; Vancouver, British Columbia), from Statistics Canada table 18-10-0001. Vector IDs are 735098 (Toronto) and 735088 (Vancouver).
